subject: pe
title: Equity: Gender, Ethnicity, Class
welcome_lead: Who plays, who watches, who leads — the politics of participation.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on inequalities in sport and policy responses.
final_note: Equal opportunity in sport is still a long way from equal outcome.

concepts.def: Generalised belief about a group, shaping access (e.g., 'centre-stacking' in football).
Invisible barrier limiting women's advancement, especially to leadership.
US law banning sex discrimination in federally funded education and sport.
Equity = needs-based provision; equality = same provision for all.
Cost, time, transport limiting working-class participation.

walkthroughs.body_html: Title IX (1972) increased US female collegiate participation from 30 000 to >220 000 today.
'Stacking' channels minority players into stereotyped positions. Coaching diversity remains poor (Rooney rule).
Elite sports (sailing, polo) remain dominated by wealthy backgrounds; community programmes seek to widen access.
